zh.title: 2D 动画：关键帧、Breakdown、循环
zh.summary: 2D 不是一张张画得漂亮，而是用关键帧和 breakdown 控制时间。先让一个动作读得懂。

zh.title: 定格动画：一张一张拍
zh.summary: 定格最磨人的地方是稳定：相机别动、光别动、动作每次只改一点。一天拍两秒很正常，别以为自己慢。

zh.title: 3D 动画管线：从 blockout 到渲染
zh.summary: 3D 不是建模完就动画。先 blockout 定时间，再 layout、animation、lighting、render，每一步都能回退。

zh.title: 动画的时间感：两张原画之间，决定重量
zh.summary: 一个球从桌上掉下来，画几张中间帧、每张隔多远，观众就能感觉到它是乒乓球还是铅球。

zh.title: 走路循环：脚落地那一下
zh.summary: 走路看起来难，是因为脚会滑、重心不对、手脚同拍。先把四个姿势站住，再谈风格。

zh.title: 口型：先对辅音，再画表情
zh.summary: 口型不是把每个字都画出来。先对闭唇的辅音，再给元音开口，表情晚半拍，观众就觉得是他在说。

zh.title: 十二原则：别一次全用
zh.summary: 十二原则不是十二个滤镜；一个动作先用一个原则解释，观众才看得懂。

zh.title: 绑定：让关节能转
zh.summary: 绑定先让关节转得对，再让皮肤变形好看；转不动，权重再细也没用。

zh.title: 字效：先读清再动
zh.summary: 字效先保证静止时读得清，再决定怎么动；边动边读，阅读速度会掉一半。

zh.title: 重量：落地的加速度
zh.summary: 重量不在姿势，在落地那几帧的加减速；没有加速度，一切像气球。

zh.title: 预备动作：让观众先知道
zh.summary: 预备动作让观众提前知道要发生什么；没有预备，动作像突然被剪进来。

zh.title: 跑步循环：脚与重心
zh.summary: 跑步循环先定重心和脚掌着地顺序，再修手臂；脚不对，全身都飘。

zh.title: 循环动作：首尾怎么接
zh.summary: 循环动作首尾帧必须对得上，否则每转一圈就抖一下。

zh.title: 二维合成：背景、前景、光
zh.summary: 二维合成把背景、人物、光效分层；全压在一张图里，改一个动作就要重画全部。

zh.title: 二维运镜：pan 与 multiplane
zh.summary: 二维运镜不是把整张图平移；用多层不同速度，才有空间。

zh.title: Blockout：先定比例和机位
zh.summary: Blockout 先定比例、机位和时长，不建模细节；这一步错了，后面全返工。

zh.title: 建模：面数与轮廓
zh.summary: 建模先看轮廓，再看面数；轮廓不对，细分再多也不像。

zh.title: 材质：粗糙度与高光
zh.summary: 材质先调粗糙度和高光，再贴纹理；这两项决定它是塑料、木头还是金属。

zh.title: 三维灯光：三点与 HDRI
zh.summary: 三维灯光先用主光、补光、轮廓光定结构，再用 HDRI 补环境；顺序反了，空间会平。

zh.title: 渲染：采样与噪点
zh.summary: 渲染先看采样和噪点，再看分辨率；噪点没压住，4K 也只是更大的脏。

zh.title: Layout：镜头与资产交接
zh.summary: Layout 把机位、比例、资产版本锁死，再交给动画；交接不清，动画师只能猜。

zh.title: 人偶骨架：能站住才能演
zh.summary: 定格人偶先能站住、能走、能重复，再谈表演；骨架软，拍十帧就塌。

zh.title: 定格布景：尺度与透视线
zh.summary: 定格布景先定人偶比例，再按镜头透视做大小；比例错了，怎么打光都假。

zh.title: 定格运动模糊：拍两遍
zh.summary: 定格运动模糊靠两次曝光或后期合成，不是把帧率调低。

zh.title: 图形转场：形状接形状
zh.summary: 图形转场让一个形状变成另一个形状，别用白闪或随便推拉。

zh.title: 信息动画：一条线只讲一件事
zh.summary: 信息动画一条线只讲一件事；线越多，观众越记不住。

zh.title: 动效节奏：音乐点与帧
zh.summary: 动效节奏先把音乐点对到帧，再决定缓入缓出；点没对上，再顺也乱。

zh.title: Animatic：配音、定时、改镜头
zh.summary: Animatic 先放配音、定每条时长、再改分镜；没有声音，时间感是假的。

zh.title: 资产交接：命名、版本、缓存
zh.summary: 资产交接写清命名、版本、缓存和依赖；少一样，下一个人就要重做。

zh.title: 短片复盘：从分镜到成片
zh.summary: 动画案例复盘按“分镜—animatic—layout—动画—灯光—合成”逐段对照，不只夸成片。

zh.title: 二维分层景深：从分层到成片
zh.summary: 二维的空间不是画出来的，是分层、速度差和遮挡一起算出来的。

zh.title: 循环动作：走、跑、呼吸的一次设计
zh.summary: 循环不是把首尾接上，而是让重心、接触和节奏在同一拍里闭合。

zh.title: 从 Blockout 到 Animatic：一条可审的动画链
zh.summary: 先看空间和时长，再看表演；blockout 与 animatic 是两道不同的审片门。

zh.title: 绑定交接：把“能拉”做成“能交”
zh.summary: 绑定交付不是骨骼能动能拉，而是极限姿势、命名和权重都能被下一位接住。

zh.title: 3D 灯光与材质：一次只改一个变量
zh.summary: 灯光和材质互相伪装；先固定一个，再判断另一个，才不会越调越糊。

zh.title: 2D/3D 合成：深度、边缘与运动
zh.summary: 合成不是把两层叠在一起，而是让深度、边缘和运动方向同时说同一种空间。

zh.title: 渲染预算：先算，再渲
zh.summary: 渲染时间不是最后才出现的问题；分辨率、采样、层数和返工次数要先算成预算。

zh.title: 动画 QC：从镜头到资产
zh.summary: 动画 QC 不是只看画面漂不漂亮，而是镜头、绑定、资产和交付命名都能被复现。

zh.title: 动效系统：从一条线到一套语法
zh.summary: 动效不是让每条线都动，而是建立层级、路径、时间和停顿的一套语法；一条线只讲一件事。

zh.title: 动画表演：给角色一个意图
zh.summary: 角色能动不等于在表演；先给意图，再做预备、动作和反应，观众才会相信它在想。

en.title: 2D Animation: Keyframes, Breakdowns, Loops
en.summary: 2D is not about beautiful drawings. It is about controlling time with keys and breakdowns. Make one action read first.

en.title: Stop Motion: One Frame at a Time
en.summary: Stop motion is a test of stability: lock the camera, lock the light, move the puppet a little each frame. Two seconds in a day is normal. You are not slow.

en.title: The 3D Pipeline: Blockout to Render
en.summary: 3D does not start with animation after modeling. Blockout sets timing, then layout, animation, lighting, and render, each step reversible.

en.title: Timing in Animation: The Weight Lives Between Two Keys
en.summary: A ball falls off a table. How many in-betweens you draw, and how far apart they sit, tells the audience whether it is a ping-pong ball or a shot put.

en.title: The Walk Cycle: The Foot Plant
en.summary: Walks look hard because feet slide, weight is wrong, and limbs move together. Lock the four poses first, then talk style.

en.title: Lip Sync: Close on Consonants, Open on Vowels
en.summary: Lip sync is not a drawing for every word. Land the closed consonants, open on the vowels, let the expression arrive late, and the audience believes the voice.

en.title: The Twelve Principles: Use One at a Time
en.summary: The twelve principles are not filters. Use one to explain one action; otherwise the audience sees noise.

en.title: Rigging: Make the Joints Turn
en.summary: Rigging makes joints turn correctly before skin looks good; if the joint fails, weights cannot save it.

en.title: Motion Typography: Read, Then Move
en.summary: Type must read at rest before it moves; reading while moving cuts comprehension in half.

en.title: Weight: The Acceleration on Landing
en.summary: Weight is not a pose; it is acceleration in the landing frames. Without it, everything floats.

en.title: Anticipation: Show the Next Move
en.summary: Anticipation tells the audience what is coming; without it, action feels pasted in.

en.title: Run Cycle: Feet and Center of Gravity
en.summary: Set the center of gravity and footfall order before arms; wrong feet make the whole body float.

en.title: Loop Cycle: Match the First and Last Frame
en.summary: The first and last frames must match, or the loop twitches every cycle.

en.title: 2D Compositing: Separate Background, Character, Light
en.summary: Separate background, character, and light. Flattened layers force a full redraw for one change.

en.title: 2D Camera: Pan and Multiplane
en.summary: A 2D camera is not one big pan; multiple layers at different speeds create space.

en.title: Blockout: Proportions and Camera First
en.summary: Blockout sets scale, camera, and timing before detail. Get it wrong and everything is redone.

en.title: Modeling: Silhouette Before Polygons
en.summary: Read the silhouette before polygon count. A wrong outline stays wrong at any density.

en.title: Materials: Roughness and Specular
en.summary: Roughness and specular decide plastic, wood, or metal before texture maps.

en.title: 3D Lighting: Three Points and HDRI
en.summary: Use key, fill, and rim to build structure, then HDRI for environment. Reverse the order and space flattens.

en.title: Render: Samples and Noise
en.summary: Samples and noise come before resolution; unresolved noise at 4K is just bigger dirt.

en.title: Layout: Camera and Asset Handoff
en.summary: Layout locks camera, scale, and asset versions before animation. A vague handoff makes animators guess.

en.title: Armature: It Must Stand Before It Acts
en.summary: A stop-motion puppet must stand, walk, and repeat before acting. A soft armature collapses in ten frames.

en.title: Stop-Motion Set: Scale and Perspective
en.summary: Set puppet scale first, then build to camera perspective. Wrong scale looks fake in any light.

en.title: Stop-Motion Motion Blur: Shoot It Twice
en.summary: Stop-motion blur comes from double exposure or post compositing, not a lower frame rate.

en.title: Motion Graphics Transition: Shape to Shape
en.summary: A graphic transition morphs one shape into another, not a white flash or random push.

en.title: Infographic Animation: One Line, One Claim
en.summary: One line carries one claim. More lines mean less memory.

en.title: Motion Rhythm: Music Beats and Frames
en.summary: Land music hits on frames before easing. Miss the hit and smoothness is still chaos.

en.title: Animatic Pipeline: Voice, Timing, Board
en.summary: Lay temp voice, set duration, then revise the board. Without sound, timing is fiction.

en.title: Asset Handoff: Names, Versions, Cache
en.summary: Handoff states names, versions, cache, and dependencies. Miss one and the next person rebuilds.

en.title: Animation Case: From Board to Final
en.summary: Review the case through board, animatic, layout, animation, lighting, and comp, not just the final.

en.title: 2D layer depth: from layers to final
en.summary: 2D space is not drawn; it is built from layers, speed differences and occlusion.

en.title: Loop design: walk, run and breathing
en.summary: A loop is not a matching first and last frame; it is weight, contact and rhythm closing on the same beat.

en.title: From blockout to animatic: a reviewable animation chain
en.summary: Space and duration first, performance second; blockout and animatic are two different review gates.

en.title: Rig handoff: from movable to deliverable
en.summary: A rig is delivered when extreme poses, naming and weights can be picked up by the next artist.

en.title: 3D light and material: one variable at a time
en.summary: Light and material disguise each other; lock one before judging the other.

en.title: 2D/3D compositing: depth, edge and motion
en.summary: Compositing is not layering; depth, edge and motion must agree on the same space.

en.title: Render budget: count before you render
en.summary: Render time is not a final-stage surprise; resolution, samples, layers and retries are a budget.

en.title: Animation QC: from shot to asset
en.summary: Animation QC is not only whether a shot looks good; shots, rigs, assets and naming must be reproducible.

en.title: Motion Graphics Systems: From One Line to a Grammar
en.summary: Motion graphics is not making every line move. It is a grammar of hierarchy, path, timing and pause, where one line carries one idea.

en.title: Animation Acting: Give the Character an Intention
en.summary: A character that moves is not necessarily acting. Give it an intention, then anticipation, action and reaction, and the audience will believe it thinks.
